scope: Round 11: identify reusable spectral formats and new UV-Vis reference datasets; no unverified traces imported.

findings.spectrum: UV-Visible absorption maxima and extinction coefficients
findings.status: peer_reviewed_dataset_metadata_verified; compound-level records not yet matched/imported

primary_source.title: Comparative dataset of experimental and computational attributes of UV/vis absorption spectra
primary_source.coverage: 18,309 experimentally determined absorption maxima records; CSV/JSON/MongoDB dataset

findings.limitation: The dataset primarily reports lambda-max and extinction coefficients where available, not necessarily full wavelength-intensity traces. Each compound identity, source citation, solvent and conditions must be matched before importing values.
findings.integration_decision: Add as discovery source only; do not treat maxima as a complete spectrum.

findings.limitation: Library describes 832 FTIR-ATR spectra of structurally confirmed reference materials. The current public listing must be searched for the target compound; no claim that ibuprofen is included.
findings.integration_decision: Use only if exact compound and provenance are confirmed; no spectrum imported.

primary_source.title: IUPAC JCAMP-DX standards and data resources
primary_source.formats: JCAMP-DX is a widely used text exchange family for spectral data; standards include IR and NMR.

findings.limitation: A format standard is not a source of measured data. The current app parser supports uncompressed XYDATA/XYPOINTS only; compressed ASDF/SQZ/DIF/DUP encodings are rejected.
findings.integration_decision: Retain as format/provenance guidance; compressed support remains future work.

scientific_note: No new experimental numerical points or full spectral curves were imported in this release. The newly identified datasets are discovery sources, not evidence that spectra have been added.
